# Ruby Gillis

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a handsome young lady known for her real showy looks and plump, showy figure. She features a brilliant complexion, large bright-blue eyes, and wears a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is also inclined to be hysterical. Heavily focused on romance, her ambitions include having numerous suitors, securing a beau by age fifteen, and teaching for only two years after finishing her studies before getting married. Additionally, she harbors a mortal fear of fat green caterpillars.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up with many big sisters who were married or courted, and she once charmed away her warts using a magic pebble from old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md). During her time as a student, she joined a story club proposed by her classmate [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Towards the end of her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Ruby visited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations and commencement plans.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are playmates who interact through their shared school life and social gatherings. Ruby is among the schoolmates who spend time with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during school events, such as Mr. Phillips's farewell speech, and who visit her during her seven-week bed rest after a fall. She also participates alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in school preparations like the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), +12 more_

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-andrews--ruby-gillis.md)

Ruby and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) are friends who spend midsummer afternoons playing games together. Their shared experiences extend through their school years to Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Ruby, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) together to anxiously discuss their upcoming final examinations and commencement plans.
